command: ! (test -e /tmp/recent_file || test -L /tmp/recent_file ) || ( stat -c 'user=%U group=%G mode=%A atime=%X mtime=%Y ctime=%Z size=%s uid=%u gid=%g %N' /tmp/recent_file 2> /dev/null || stat -f 'user=%Su group=%Sg mode=%Sp atime=%a mtime=%m ctime=%c size=%z uid=%u gid=%g %N%SY' /tmp/recent_file || ( ls -ld /tmp/recent_file && ls -ldn /tmp/recent_file ) )
